theorems.name: Submission.lpf_simple_nvector_algebra
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Eucl P), ‖simpleNVector v‖ ^ 2 = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)).det) ∧ ∀ (P n : ℕ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), simpleNVector (fun i => ∑ j, B i j • τ j) = B.det • simpleNVector τ
